name: ESO 223-G009 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 223-G009, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso223g009-hubble
story: A lone, gas-rich dwarf irregular galaxy lying behind the Centaurus A/M 83 galaxy complex, in a part of the sky heavily dimmed by dust. It still holds plenty of gas to keep making new stars.

claims.text: ESO 223-G009 is the galaxy's designation; HIPASS J1501-48 is another name
ESO 223-09 is an isolated dwarf irregular (dIrr) galaxy behind and east of the Cen A/M 83 complex
It lies in a zone of strong extinction (heavily dimmed by dust)
It has a lot of gas for continuing star formation
It was observed with HST/ACS in proposals 9771 and 10235 (Centaurus galaxies)
